z_convention: positive z = measured above predicted, for every parameter and equation
abnormal_rule: parameters whose name starts with X are abnormal when z < lln_z; all others when z > uln_z

frequency_map.note: Used only when the chosen set has no row at the device's native frequency: Resmon/Tremoflo R11, R19, X11, R5-R19 are then scored with the 10 and 20 Hz rows of Berger, Oostveen, GR, Nowowiejska or Wu. Ducharme and Valach have native 11/19 Hz rows and are never mapped.

device_defaults.note: Primary equation by device and age group. Adults and Jaeger children agreed 2026-09-29 (Alex): Berger (Jaeger) and Oostveen (Resmon, Tremoflo) for adults, Gochicoa-Rangel for children. Resmon/Tremoflo children set to the device-matched Ducharme 2022 equations PENDING Alex's sign-off. Valach 2026 (Resmon, adults) available as a sensitivity set. Nowowiejska and Wu kept only to reproduce Paper 1.

sets.label: Berger 2021
sets.citation: Berger KI et al. ERJ Open Res 2021;7:00560-2020
sets.population: 472 healthy never-smoking adults, lower Manhattan (WTC control cohort)
notes: Earlier pipelines used the R5-15 row for R5-R20 and ln(4 - X) for X5/X10; both corrected here.
Valid ranges are the sex-specific age and height ranges of the derivation sample (Table 2).

sets.label: Oostveen 2013
sets.citation: Oostveen E et al. Eur Respir J 2013;42:1513-23
notes: Units are hPa (1 hPa = 0.1 kPa = 1.0197 cmH2O); older pipelines treated them as cmH2O (about 0.07 SD shift for Rrs).
Resmon and Tremoflo measure 11 and 19 Hz; the 10 and 20 Hz rows are applied to them (frequency_map).
No published R5-R20 equation; z-scores for R5-R19 are not produced from this set.
Male valid height 1.59-1.97 m, age 18-84; female 1.47-1.88 m, age 19-81.

sets.label: Gochicoa-Rangel 2023
sets.citation: Gochicoa-Rangel L et al. ERJ Open Res 2023;9:00503-2023
notes: Earlier code used closed intervals (e.g. 2.70-7.36, 7.37-19.10), so ages between them returned NA.
Sex coded male = 1 (signs consistent with lower R and AX in males); confirm against the Methods text.

sets.label: Nowowiejska 2008
sets.citation: Nowowiejska B et al. Pediatr Pulmonol 2008;43:1193-7; erratum 2020;55:254
notes: The paper writes z = (measured - predicted)/RSD, but for the exponential models the RSD (about 0.2) is on the log scale; z is computed on ln(y). This matches the published pediatric analysis.

sets.label: Wu 2022
sets.citation: Wu J et al. Respir Res 2022;23:182
notes: Height coefficients rounded to 0.001 per cm: at 150 cm a rounding error of 0.0005 shifts the prediction by up to 0.075 kPa, about 0.3 SD for R5. Obtain Table S1 if it reports more digits.

sets.label: Ducharme 2022 (Resmon)
sets.citation: Ducharme FM et al. Pediatr Pulmonol 2022;57:2092-2102
sets.device_derived: Resmon Pro FULL (5-11-19 Hz and 8 Hz signals)
notes: Standing height only; age, weight and sex are not predictors (age is used only for the valid range).
R8 and X8 rows come from the 8 Hz single-frequency signal; all others from 5-11-19 Hz.
Rrs: mean on a log link, sigma in kPa (see build_coefficients.py for the Figure 3 check).
Sigma falls linearly with height; at 180 cm the X5 LLN sits only about 0.035 kPa below predicted. Interpret tall adolescents with care.
No AX or Fres equations for Resmon in this paper.

sets.label: Ducharme 2022 (tremoflo)
sets.citation: Ducharme FM et al. Pediatr Pulmonol 2022;57:2092-2102; correction Pediatr Pulmonol 2025;60:e27409
sets.device_derived: tremoflo C-100 (AOS 5-37 Hz and 7-41 Hz waveforms)
notes: AX and Fres are waveform specific: score as AX_5_37 / AX_7_41 and Fres_5_37 / Fres_7_41. refeq_score_long builds the name from the mode column and refuses to guess.
R and X at shared frequencies were averaged across the two waveforms by the authors; 5 Hz rows need the 5-37 waveform, 7 Hz rows the 7-41 waveform.
Mayo data dictionary: tremoflo waveform field is 'AOS 5-37 - Adult' or 'AOS 7-41 - Pediatric'.
AX: sqrt(AX) = a + b*Ht, constant SEE; LLN is floored at 0.

sets.label: Valach 2026 (LEAD)
sets.citation: Valach C et al. ERJ Open Res 2026;12:00159-2025
sets.source_table: Tables 2-5; supplementary Tables S1-S2 (11 and 19 Hz)
sets.population: 887 healthy never-smoking adults, Austrian LEAD cohort (Vienna)
notes: LMS: z = ((y'/M)^L - 1)/(L*S), y' = shifted value. X is shifted to 1 - X, so its raw z is sign-flipped here (orientation -1).
Male AX_exp not implemented: the published S formula duplicates the M formula (implied CoV about 3.5). Ask the authors or check the supplement.
Height range of the derivation sample is not published in the main text (male IQR 173-183 cm, female 160-169 cm); only age and BMI are range-checked.
R11, R19, X11, X19 (total and within-breath) from supplementary Tables S1-S2; X11 shift 2 - X, X19 shift 3 - X.
Both supplement worked examples (male R5 z = -2.375281; female X5_exp z = +1.839774 after orientation) are reproduced to 6 decimals.
